Battle Crusher.name: Battle Crusher
Battle Crusher.summary: Battle Crusher is a fighting game released on the Game Boy.

Roadster.name: Roadster

World Cup Striker.name: Elite Soccer
World Cup Striker.summary: Elite Soccer was also released for the Game Boy. Developed by Denton Designs, it was also published in Japan by Coconuts Japan as "World Cup Striker", and in Europe as "Soccer".
